title: Events and seasons
summary: Invasions, the Halloween season, staff events, the battle pass and the daily orders.

blocks.text: Invasion : a gate opens the sky, waves then a world boss. Seasons : the Halloween season and the battle pass season. Staff events : XP storm, shard rain, lucky surge, rift storm, party. Daily : orders, free tower tickets, login streak.
